newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call easy, security prices continue rally.
newsitem.headline: Indian call easy, security prices continue rally.

text.p: Indian call money rates opened at 1.50-2.00 percent on Tuesday compared to the previous close of 1.00-1.50 percent, dealers said.
Call rates eased to 1.25-1.75 percent in latest deals, they said. The rates are expected to slide down further to 1.0 percent levels towards the close on poor demand from borrowers, dealers said.
Securities prices are expected to continue the rally on Tuesday, they said.

In the latest trades, the 12.59 percent government stock 2004 was quoted at 102.43 rupees against the previous trade of 102.29 rupees, 12.50 percent 2004 at 102.10 rupees against 101.79 rupees and the 12.14 percent 2000 stock was quoted at 103.20 rupees against its previous 103.05 rupees, they said.
